facts.claim: The Coorg Rebellion was a rise of the Gaudas, a tribe on the Western slope of the Ghats who resemble the Coorgs in many of their habits.
facts.quote: The so-called Coorg Rebellion was properly speaking a rise of the Gaudas, a tribe on the Western slope of the Ghats who resemble the Coorgs in many of their habits.

facts.claim: The districts of Amara Sulya, Puttur and BantwAla had been retransferred to the province of Canara after being taken from Coorg.
facts.quote: After the annexation of Coorg, the districts of Amara Sulya, Puttur and BantwAla, the latter adjoining that of Mangalore, had been retransferred to the province of Canara, from which they had been taken.

facts.claim: Under the Coorg R&jahs, the assessment had been paid in kind, but the Collector of Mangalore now demanded cash payment.
facts.quote: Under the Coorg R&jahs, the assessment had been paid in kind. The Collector of Mangalore now demand- ed cash payment.
